items.q: Is BizApp365 ready for UAE e-invoicing?
items.a: Yes. BizApp365 submits e-invoices through a Peppol / ASP access point with QR codes, tracks submission status and retries automatically if a submission fails.

items.q: Does it support both UAE and Oman VAT?
items.a: Yes. Companies can run in VAT mode with UAE or Oman filing reports, including the UAE VAT 201 box breakdown. A GST mode is also available.

items.q: Can my team use it in Arabic?
items.a: Every screen and printed document is available in English and Arabic, with true right-to-left layout. Each user can switch language at any time.

items.q: How does the Android VAN app connect?
items.a: Scan a QR code (or open a bizapp365:// link) to configure the server. Sales, returns, receipts and van stock sync with the web ERP.

items.q: Can I print without the browser print dialog?
items.a: Yes. The Direct Print extension for Windows prints invoices and barcode labels silently, with separate printer profiles for each document type.

items.q: Can we host it on our own server?
items.a: Yes. BizApp365 runs on Docker with HTTPS, so it can be deployed on-premise as well as in the cloud. Talk to us about your setup.
